records.title: Code2World: A GUI World Model via Renderable Code Generation
records.category: GUI world prediction through renderable code; next-observation model, not persistent application reconstruction
records.classification_note: Code2World generates HTML for a predicted next GUI screenshot conditioned on the current screenshot and action. The learned model supplies the transition prediction; the emitted HTML renders that observation. It does not synthesize a reusable state-transition function or recover a complete interactive application. C records the renderable-program artifact and E the learned world-prediction role. This is a bridge categorization within the existing broad C family, not a claim of raw-video input or full V5 behavior recovery.
